findings.message: The $enable parameter of ob_implicit_flush() expects a boolean value instead of an integer since PHP 8.0. Found: 1 (an integer passed to a bool parameter is converted without an error unless the file uses strict_types)

INI directive 'mbstring.func_overload' is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

'resource' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 7.0 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (resource has been a soft reserved name since PHP 7.0 and naming a class Resource never raises an error, so nothing changes on newer PHP)
